snippet.title: 🎮 Hard West 2 Announcement trailer | PlayStation 5 | Xbox Series X|S
snippet.description:
Hard West 2, a turn-based tactics game set in a dark, occult vision of the Wild West, will be released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

THE GOOD, THE BAD AND THE SUPERNATURAL

Hard West 2 takes players deep into unforgiving wastelands, where revolver bullets collide with dark magic drawn straight from forgotten tales. Discover the story of Gin Carter, a legendary outlaw who sets out on a mission to rob the mysterious “Ghost Train.” However, it soon becomes clear that gold will not be your main objective — instead, you will face the task of reclaiming your own soul. To achieve this, together with your posse you will travel across the diverse lands of the Weird West, fighting a variety of enemies and taking part in duels, train robberies, and horseback chases.

WISHLIST and FOLLOW:
▶ PS: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016848
▶ XB: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9MXQXWV8CLV6
